Doji desafía a Kyoya a una batalla; acuerdan que si Kyoya pierde, tendrá que trabajar para que Doji derrote a Gingka. La pelea está en marcha y Rock Leone de Kyoya resulta no ser rival para el Lobo Oscuro de Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei está devastado por la pérdida de su mentor Kyoya, quien se unió a Doji como una forma de pagar una deuda. Así que Benkei se sorprende al recibir una visita del mismo Doji que le presenta un poderoso Beyblade, Dark Bull. A cambio, Doji quiere que Benkei lo use para derrotar a Gingka. Benkei acepta y entrena duro. Gingka y Benkei luchan y el Pegaso de Gingka prevalece al final. Por un momento parece que los dos enemigos se harán amigos, pero no es para ser ...

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka se niega a luchar contra un villano obsesionado con los cangrejos llamado Tetsuya Watarigani, pero cuando Watarigani revela que se ha llevado a Madoka y no la liberará hasta que Gingka acepte luchar, Gingka no tiene otra opción. Se produce una batalla acalorada, con mucho juego encubierto por parte de Watarigani. Justo cuando Gingka está contra la pared, Madoka regresa. Ella fue salvada por nada menos que ... Benkei.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion

Ella sabe que debe vencer a Gingka, así que lo desafía a través de Benkei. Gingka se ha resfriado y Madoka insiste en que descanse un poco antes de volver a luchar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei es mentor de Kenta para que el joven espadachín pueda enfrentar a Hikaru nuevamente y derrotarla. Mientras tanto, Hikaru descubre que no derrotó a Gingka, fue Kenta haciéndose pasar por Gingka.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion

Mientras tanto, los jóvenes amigos de Kenta le ruegan a Benkei que los entrene también y él cede.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kyoya regresa de Wolf Canyon, disuelve a los Cazadores de caras y desafía a Benkei a una batalla que resulta ser destructiva. Kenta llega para ayudar a Benkei, pero fue en vano: los ataques de Kyoya son tan intensos que el almacén en sí está destruido. Mientras tanto, Gingka alcanza a Hikaru, la felicita por su batalla con Kenta y la reta a una batalla.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion

Gingka promete hacerlo justo cuando Benkei comienza a roncar. Gingka encuentra con Kyoya y la lucha está en Kyoya con la creación de un tornado que rasga a través de la ciudad. La multitud se reúne y anima a Gingka.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: búsquedas gingka para Doji y la sede de la nebulosa oscura determinaron para encontrar Prohibida Bey de Doji, L-Drago, que es el mal. La pandilla ayuda a Gingka a buscar, pero no es hasta que Kyoya aparece con una pista de que pueden encontrar la Nebulosa Oscura. Fuera de la fortaleza, Doji envía una variedad de ataques beyblade su camino.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Gingka, Kyoya, Kenta, Madoka y Benkei paseo por el castillo Dark Nebula donde la voz de Doji reta para que sea a la planta superior. Ellos tratan de subir, pero Merci ha puesto en marcha una serie de obstáculos para ellos, incluyendo el mal patinadores individuales. Kyoya insiste en que puede manejarlos mientras Gingka continúa solo. Kyoya utiliza Lion 100 Fang Fury y derriba a los gemelos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: En el interior del castillo de Dark Nebula, Gingka encuentra cara a cara con un némesis perdido hace mucho tiempo ... Ryuga que lleva el Bey Prohibida, L-Drago. Gingka revela que Ryuga es la única persona que nunca perdonará. A sobreviene de batalla en el que la ira de los combustibles gingka L-Drago poder. Ryuga le incita a ir contando Gingka que su padre no era fuerte tampoco.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta se enfrenta a Gingka y Gingka habla sobre su pasado. Nos enteramos de que el padre de Gingka, Ryo, era el dueño original del Bey Pegasus y un archirival de Ryuga. Ryuga derrotó a Ryo en una batalla entre Pegasus y el Prohibido Bey Lightning L-Drago. Las últimas palabras de Ryo a su hijo son derrotar a Ryuga para que pueda devolver a L-Drago al lugar que le corresponde.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kenta encuentra una carta de Gingka que dice adiós, la pandilla se dispuso a encontrarlo en su pueblo natal de Koma Village. Frente a los desafíos de cruzar una montaña traicionera en el camino hacia la aldea, Kyoya y Benkei toman una ruta mientras que Madoka y Kenta toman otra. Ambas partes se encuentran independientemente con un misterioso viajero llamado Hyoma que los ayuda, pero al mismo tiempo parece no decir la verdad.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Benkei, Kyoya, Kenta y Madoka siguen a su nueva guía, Hyoma, por los traicioneros senderos de montaña mientras intentan encontrar la aldea de Koma y reunirse con Gingka. Tanto Kenta como Benkei luchan contra Hyoma y su bey Aries y son derrotados.

programme.title: La Sucursal del Infierno
programme.desc: El recién nombrado capitán de la policía es puesto a cargo de disolver un grupo de narcotraficantes. él y sus hombres acorralarán a los criminales hasta descubrir que la esposa del capitán ha sido asesinada. ahora, la motivación para atrapar a los criminales será personal. La joven ruth, que habia sido violada por su padre, se casa con el anciano nazario, dueño del club nocturno local, pero como este interfiere con sus sueños, ella planea su asesinato con la complicidad de la corrupta autoridad local.

programme.desc: El bato loco como lo dice en el corrido, un hombre valiente y de muchas agallas, llamado Emilio Beltrán, por un conflicto de opresión campesina sale herido de muerte su padre Don Jacinto Beltrán y se ven en la necesidad de matar a un hombre por defenderse, mandado por el cacique y opresor de los campesinos, un gringo llamado Mr. Williams que como mujer tiene a través de un abuso y como pago de una deuda de un campesino muy humilde a una mujer llamada Roció profundamente enamorada del bato loco y a pesar del dolor de una madre tiene que dejar su tierra para emigrar a los estados unidos en el estado de Texas, en donde se encuentra a un camarada que de primera instancia le intenta robar su mochila.

programme.title: Rocheuses sauvages

UFC stars such as Simeon Thoreson, Luke 'Bigslow' Barnatt, RiccoRodriguez,Thierry "The African Assassin" Sokoudjou, Phil De Fries, Paul Kelly to name but a few, have graced the UWC cage. UWC continues to grow and to bring the fight fans across Europe the fights they want to see.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Season 11 is here and we’re kicking things off where every Florida Keys adventure begins: Key Largo. In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The next stop on our Florida Keys adventure brings Rush Maltz to the legendary waters of Islamorada — a destination known for its laid-back island vibe, world-class fishing, fine dining, and easy access to the reef. Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge

The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: DUPR Collegiate National Championship

This clash of titans proves why these two programs are the gold standard of collegiate pickleball, where every "point two" earned is a grueling step toward national history.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: 96 Robots, down to four. The Grand Final is here and the competition is fierce, only the best robot will survive and win the title of Robot Wars: The Sixth Wars champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four robots from Germany, four robots from the UK. The competitors will fight their fellow compatriots for a chance to represent their country in a Germany against UK final, to decide which country has the most ferocious machine.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Using competitors own video diaries, exclusive action from the pits and the best of the battles, Philippa Forrester will get down to the nuts and bolts of Robot Wars, The Second Wars.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Philippa goes behind the scenes to find out how the shows fighting machines are made, whilst uncovering the trials and tribulations of their frantic creators.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Another visit behind the scenes of Robot Wars Series 2, more exclusive footage and access to the pits shows every nook and cranny of this week’s competitors.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Witness hope, triumph, desperation and defeat as Philippa takes us back to the pits, where competitors make final touches to their Robots, hoping they come back in one piece.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Get a glimpse of how the production team setup the arena for contests such as jousting and pinball. Gain an insight as to how competitors construct their robots from team video diaries.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Follow Team Chaos's journey. From humble beginnings to how they ended up building one of the most feared Robots ever to compete.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An extensive and informative dive behind-the-scenes on the House Robots. Get inside information from designer Chris Reynolds, on what goes into creating these killing machines.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A competitor feels the heat of the house robots in the first round. One competitor’s weapon easily immobilizes their opponent, leaving it for the house robots to play with. Two similar robots meet in the final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Eight more competitors brave the Robot Wars arena. One of the robot’s attacks backfires in the semi-finals, leading to a tight final with an unexpected conclusion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer makes it to the semi-finals, will they hold their own against the veterans? Two-time World Champions and Fifth Wars Champions Razer battle first as they attempt to gain yet another title.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: An all veteran, action-packed semi-final. The house robots do not hesitate to get involved as the competitors do anything it takes to eliminate their opponents. The Loser’s Melee gives knocked out competitors a chance for redemption.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: 96 Robots, down to four. The Grand Final is here and the competition is fierce, only the best robot will survive and win the title of Robot Wars: The Sixth Wars champion.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four robots from Germany, four robots from the UK. The competitors will fight their fellow compatriots for a chance to represent their country in a Germany against UK final, to decide which country has the most ferocious machine.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Extreme series begins with a vengeance battle to settle a bitter rivalry. Two All-stars battles to put the fan favourites up against each other and a final battle with the Challenge belt at stake to up the pressure for the competitors.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This action-packed episode features several battles, including Wild Card Warriors, Middleweight Championship and Vengeance. All building up to the main event; Mayhem Battle, where three veterans fight for glory.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The battles this episode include; All-stars, another Mayhem battle and the Challenge belt. Robots from the UK, USA, The Netherlands and Germany fight for your entertainment and their pride in International Inferno.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A rivalry will be settled in tonight’s main event, a vengeance battle between Razer and Pussycat. Razer claims in their last fight Pussycat had broken a “Gentleman’s Agreement” by causing unnecessary damage after the robot was immobilised.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Tag Team Terror, Mayhem and Vengeance all precede this episode’s main event, a one-off Armed Forces Mayhem. Robots from the British Army, Navy and Royal Air Force go to war to prove who is most efficient in combat.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Two robots fight over the title “Best showman” in this episode’s Vengeance Main Event. In the build-up, we see a three way International Melee between the UK, Belgium and The Netherlands, Tag Team Terror, Challenge Belt and Mayhem battle.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six robots will be reduced down to one in this annihilator episode. Qualifiers from the Mayhem battles previously in the series. Which competitor will battle through the four rounds and defeat the opposition in the final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Extreme series returns to its normal format after the first Annihilator. Four mixed battles, followed by a Main Event, which in this episode is an All-Stars battle between Pussycat and Stinger.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Shunt and Dead Metal prepare to be let loose from the sidelines in this episodes Main Event, House Robot Rebellion. Three unfortunate competitors will be put into the arena as the House Robots have free reign in this destructive episode.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: We have reached the Quarter Finals for the All-Stars battles in this episode’s Main Event and another Mayhem battle puts another three robots up against each other.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Four of the best robots armed with rear-hinged flippers go against each other to prove whose best in Flipper Frenzy. Other battles on the card are the Challenge Belt, Tag Team Terror, Wild Card Warriors and Mayhem battle.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Current World Champions Razer are matched against fierce competitor Firestorm in this All-stars match. Four robots make their way to the arena to take part in the German Melee, with the winner securing a place in the Second World Championship.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The Featherweight Championship takes place in this episode, along with the Challenge Belt, Mayhem battle and more Wildcard Warriors. All these build-up to the Main event, the Tag Team Terror finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The second annihilator was supposed to be between the six winners of the mayhem qualifiers, but due to the severity of damage from the battle, two of the robots had to be replaced. Will the two replacements seize this opportunity?

programme.title: Creative Crochet Corner presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Creative Crochet Corner is an online video streaming service all about learning how to crochet! Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Curved or straight, pieces define the design. Modern quilter Jen Carlton-Bailly uses templates to create contemporary curves. Fiber artist Shelly Gilliland joins Heather Grant with ideas for a quilting service day. Textile artist Chawne Kimber's colorful designs emerge as she pieces and sews a log cabin design with very small strips.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela shows you how to make half-square triangles two at a time for a dazzling quilt that's beaming with color.

programme.title: Bonus: Painter's Tape for Faster Quilting
programme.desc: As quilters, we make lots of HSTs (half-square triangles). If you like the two-at-a-time method, Angela has the hack for you! Watch as she uses painter's tape to sew quarter-inch seams instead of marking each square.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: CAUTION: Baby quilts are a total gateway drug! Just ask Angela: she's working this cute little number up for her newborn nephew. (Think you can stop at one? Don't say we didn't warn you!)

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Stitching designs or patterns on the surface of your fabric can be the perfect embellishment. Joanne Banko demonstrates machine embroidery on a kimono style dress. Then, Rebecca Kemp Brent explores visible mending - stitching that is meant to be seen and provides a decorative accent.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: It's fun to bead with friends. With a color palette for inspiration, Erin Prais-Hintz spills her beading secrets as she and Katie plan a beading party and give you more ideas for jewelry-making get-togethers. Katie uses vintage-style sliders to make glamorous chandelier earrings.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Raid your art box for paint and gesso as we paint our way to fantastic layouts. Create Stencils with Jenny Barnett Rohrs, a layout from Ronda Palazzari with a technique for changing patterned paper into unique embellishments with gesso, and watercolors, and the fourth level (that's more than the third!) of dimension from Kim Hupke on a page entitled "my girl".

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Shake up your workspace. Host Julie Fei Fan Balzer, known for her colorful aprons, shares how to make your own to reflect your mood and art style. Then, meet Kristin Gambaccini to create a simple but unique plant stand to bring a living plant into your studio. Finally, Micah Goguen shows how to make heirloom light catchers. Last is a color study -- the color purple.

programme.title: National Sewing Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to sew, step-by-step with National Sewing Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Quilting just got better. Join Angela in her first episode as she stitches up her exclusive variable-star quilt design.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Quilting just got better. Join Angela in her first episode as she stitches up her exclusive variable-star quilt design.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Can’t get enough of bargello? Angela Walters shows you how to make a ravishing rainbow quilt using precut fabric strip sets.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: WARNING: The following content depicts excessive charm square usage and may be too exciting for most quilters. In other words, Angela's ready to take on 200+ precuts, and the accompanying placement decisions.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela's been challenged by The Crafty Gemini to make a stash-busting tote bag. So she's stepping outside her comfort zone and up to the #MidnightStashChallenge!

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: Skillset Dinners for Busy Weeknights
programme.desc: Welcome to CraftsyTV's Cook & Create, where delectable delights meet crafty creators.

programme.title: Artist's Academy presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Short Rows
programme.desc: Learn to knit, step-by-step with The Knitting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Master bowyer Tom Turgeon joins George Vondriska in the workshop to show you how to make your own long-bow. They'll discuss the kits available on the market and demystify the terminology used when talking about bow making. Learn about the art and intricac

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.desc: Capture travel memories in photos and in writing. Sewing artist Kim Montagnese uses computer software to create new images for artful designs and quilts. Embroidery expert Eileen Roche sews a monogrammed journal cover of faux suede. Serger expert Angela Wolf has a tip for serging seams.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: So you’ve finished knitting your Novel-T, now what? Tune in to see how to weave in the ends when working with cotton yarn. Hint: this method involves fabric glue.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: The ladies are going big by thinking small! From compact cables to cute mini skeins, this one's all about the tiny treasures that keep those needles clicking.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Inspiration comes from animals and creatures -- real and imaginary. Katie makes a 3-D owl with textured wings makes a great decoration for any room. Franz and Katie make creature creation a team sport by drawing three-part fantasy animals together. Jenny looks to the sea to find inspiration for a jelly-fish made from re-cycled materials then Katie creates a glittery clay lizard textured with found items. From the Family Craft box make a pair of bear claw slippers made from tissue boxes.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids

programme.title: Ellis Family Vacation

programme.title: Descending
programme.desc: Scott and Ellis visit South Africa to face their fears and brave some of the most notorious shark-filled waters in the world. Disaster strikes on what should have been an easy shipwreck dive.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: Kimberly and Elsa face off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day and showcase its rich culture.

programme.title: America's Musical Journey
programme.desc: A cross-country adventure through the musical heritage of America.

programme.title: America's Musical Journey
programme.desc: A cross-country adventure through the musical heritage of America.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin meet up with Robel, who takes the guys to visit his sisters in his village of Harar. They visit the bustling chat market, and learn how to prepare the traditional stimulant. That night, Robel takes them to feed some wild hyenas by hand. Leaving Harar, they take a long drive to visit the Hammer Tribe. Here they witness a rare ceremony in which the women of the village offer themselves to be whipped, and one soon-to-be married man has to run, stark naked over a dozen bulls, to prove his worth as a husband.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Rwanda is a country emerging from its darkest years of poaching and the 1994 genocide. Scott and Justin travel with locals to learn more about how Rwanda is managing today. They explore the recovery of the animal population – from swimming cows on Napoleon Island to trekking into the wild to visit isolated groups of mountain gorillas. This experience is contrasted with a visit to the church of Ntarama to talk to a genocide survivor, and a court tribunal of several accused men. The guys hear stories of forgiveness from the people, and learn of their hope for their country.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys arrive in the arctic destination at the beginning of winter. With only six hours of sunlight a day, they experience an entirely different type of adventure. Arriving by helicopter into the town of Ittoqqortoormiit, they take part in a seat hunt, and learn of the many ways people survive in this harsh arctic climate. With some basic training under their belt, the team heads off on a three-day trek to the abandoned ghost town of Cape Hope, where weather and extreme conditions pushes everyone’s utmost limits.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Scott and Justin are prepared for perhaps their greatest adventure to date, providing them with a rare glimpse inside the borders of this isolated country. From Beijing, they depart to Pyongyang with an Englishman named Nick – an outsider with unprecedented access to the country. Meeting up with their local guides, Chae and Kim, the team visits many historical and political sights, learning the local perspective on world events, and gaining a much greater understanding of the country. An evening cruise down the Taedong River begins to cement a solid friendship between the guys and their guides.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: North Koreans are a fiercely proud and creative people. North Korea continues to completely defy all expectations, as Scott and Justin take part in a high school English class, are pulled into numerous musical performances, visit a water bottling factory, a farm and an old funfair. Their experiences are capped off by the largest and most impressive choreographed spectacle on earth – the Arirang Mass Games – where 100,000 people perform the ultimate homage to their country and ideologies. The guys are sad to leave their trusted guides and friends behind when they depart by train back to Beijing.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The trip begins on the caldera of Mount Bromo - an active, yet serene volcano in the middle of the island of Java. With their local friend Oka, they continue to the slums of Jakarta, meeting with a young boy and his family, and participating in daily activities to learn of the many hardships facing the locals. Heading to the island paradise of Bali, they take part in an explosive, traditional bull race. Scott gets “dirty” while Oka loses his chariot altogether. The trip winds down when they meet a Balinesian Prince, and join his party as guests of honour.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: For three years, Scott and Justin have travelled the globe, experiencing so many people’s homes, while getting further away from their own. In their friend Oka’s home island of Bali, the guys witness both spiritual and illegal aspects of Balinesian life - grand temples, noisy bird markets and betting on underground cricket fights. They then travel back in time to the island of Sumba, staying overnight with a tribe who live in close harmony with nature and their ancestors. While Justin ponders returning home, Scott realizes that after three years on the road, there are more similarities between people and cultures than differences.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: From the southern coast of Adelaide, all the way to Darwin, the guys take on another road trip - this time with their own purchased 4x4 to get them through the perilous, dusty outback. Fighting constant breakdowns, they reach the underground town of Coober Pedy, where they search for opal with the help of an explosives “expert”. The crew travel from Uluru, staying on a working ranch, before tackling the ultimate off-road adventure through searing sand to remote Boggy Hole. Pushing on through a sudden rainstorm in the north, to the last miles to Darwin, Scott, Justin, and Andre have now travelled to all seven continents. What’s next?

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We go sea to summit with a skiing experience. We trek to an unskiied peak then go diving in the frozen ocean. Then we learn about sauna culture and how activity should be fun not work

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: From environmental health to physical health, we discover what coastal life is like in Morocco before heading inland to the desert.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We trek into the Sahara for an overnight camp and then visit the nomads. We learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: “Pura Vida” is a popular saying in Costa Rica, often translated as “pure life” or “simple life.” We will learn from centenarians from the Blue Zone why we should live a pure life.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We learn about conservation in Costa Rica from reforestation projects, to sustainable fishing and endangered turtle rescue. Learn why they believe in sustainability.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Why does Sardinia stand alone as Europes Healthiest Community? Is the coast, the pastures or the mountains that grant its residences with longevity?

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Sardinia teaches lessons of community, social connection and good foods - we learn from Dr. Ivo Pirisi what makes this island so special.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We travel to La Paz Bolivia to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, I visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: The high altitude environment makes foods that are considered “super”. From quinoai, to special beans and salt – We travel from the Uyuni Salt flats back to La Paz to work with a Master Chef.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We travel to the world’s highest lake to see what is happening in this fragile ecosystem. We finish our Bolivian adventure with a ceremony honouring our planet.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: Our small team shares our most impactful moments, stories, places and people in our wrap up episode. We share the things we brought home and how they changed our lives and our health.

programme.title: Lucky In Love
programme.desc: Alana and her boyfriend, Josh, visit Fort Worth, Texas, letting fate guide their itinerary. The coin toss leads to unexpected and exciting experiences in the city.

programme.title: Lucky In Love
programme.desc: Gary and Dean explore the capital city by the toss of a coin. Their journey includes activities ranging from kayaking on the Potomac River to trying the city's best chili dogs.

programme.title: Lucky In Love
programme.desc: Rachel and Paul explore The Big Easy by letting a coin toss decide their path, creating a unique way to discover the city's culture and attractions

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: Anything is possible in Russia. Scott and Justin meet up with their friend Bogdan and visit the last man living in the radioactive zone in Chernobyl. They visit St. Petersburg for some homemade vodka and to celebrate Bogdan’s birthday, before hopping on an overnight train to Moscow. The adventures in Moscow are diverse: An awkward visit to a Russian bath, a wild night out in an exhilarating dance club and a chance to drive a cold-war military tank. Next, they fly to Siberia and meet a vodka-slamming shaman, who puts them all to shame on the dance floor.

programme.title: Departures
programme.desc: The guys head northeast into Siberia to reach the coldest inhabited place on earth: the Pole of Cold. Along the way, the word of Scott and Justin’s journey travels and they become local news celebrities. They visit a permanent circus, take part in the Festival of Cold, answer questions at local press conferences and end up judging a quirky beauty contest in Yakutsk. Riding reindeer for the rest of the trek, they camp in the snow before hitting the Pole of Cold.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.
